stories.headline: Kast launches border barrier construction with Peru as part of 'Plan Escudo Fronterizo'
stories.summary: President José Antonio Kast visited Chile's northern border to oversee the start of trench and wall construction along the Peru border, fulfilling a key campaign promise. The plan includes physical barriers, military deployment, and surveillance technology to combat illegal immigration and drug trafficking.

stories.headline: Kast withdraws 43 environmental decrees from Boric administration
stories.summary: The new Chilean government announced the suspension of 43 environmental protection measures from the previous administration, including rules on pollution, emissions, and national park protections. The move represents a significant policy reversal from the Boric era.

stories.headline: Kast presents National Reconstruction Plan with tax cuts and economic measures
stories.summary: President Kast announced a comprehensive economic package including corporate tax reductions from 27% to 23%, elimination of property taxes for seniors, and temporary VAT elimination for home purchases. The plan aims to stimulate economic growth and reconstruction efforts.

stories.headline: Kast begins presidency with high approval ratings across multiple polls
stories.summary: Multiple polling organizations show President Kast starting his term with approval ratings between 47-59%, higher than his predecessor Gabriel Boric's initial ratings. The polls also show strong support for his border security and economic initiatives.

stories.headline: Carabineros sergeant Javier Figueroa dies after being shot in Puerto Varas
stories.summary: Sergeant Javier Figueroa Manquemilla died after being shot in the head during a police operation in Puerto Varas on March 11. The 36-year-old officer had 15 years of service and leaves behind a wife and 7-year-old son. President Kast declared three days of national mourning.

stories.headline: Kast meets with military branch leaders and designates new ambassadors
stories.summary: President Kast held meetings with the commanders of Chile's Army, Navy, and Air Force during his first week in office. He also announced new ambassador appointments to international organizations including the UN, OAS, and OECD.

stories.headline: Chile's economy grew 2.5% in 2025, completing Boric's term with 2% average growth
stories.summary: Chile's Central Bank reported the economy expanded 2.5% in 2025, driven by investment and consumer spending. This gave the outgoing Boric administration an average growth rate of 2% over its four-year term, though below historical averages.

stories.headline: Foreign investment in Chile reached US$14.152 billion in 2025, up 13%
stories.summary: Chile's foreign direct investment closed 2025 at US$14.152 billion, a 13% increase from the previous year. The growth was driven mainly by profit reinvestment and exceeded the historical average, positioning Chile as a regional investment destination.

stories.headline: CODELCO's production drops 47% in January, raising questions about December surge
stories.summary: Chile's state copper giant CODELCO reported a sharp production drop to 91,000 tons in January 2026, down 47% from December's record 172,300 tons. Industry analysts question the sustainability of the year-end surge that helped meet 2025 targets.

stories.summary: Opposition parties, particularly Frente Amplio, criticized Kast's early policy moves including the border plan and environmental rollbacks.
